idea-plugin.name: Narrately Collector
idea-plugin.description:
Reports editor activity to the local Narrately collector daemon so your daily developer log can be generated automatically.

Captures focus time, saves, edit volume, debug sessions, and the active git branch.

Privacy: file paths, language ids, timestamps, and integer counts only. File contents are never stored or transmitted. All data stays on 127.0.0.1.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 1.1.0 — Deeper editor enrichers: edit-volume tracking (lines added/removed), debug session spans, idle detection so time away from the keyboard is not counted as coding, and git branch context.
